source.title: Call for Applications - WCA Appeals Committee Members (March 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Appeals Committee (WAC) is looking for new members! Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Due to the nature of the WAC’s work, the following requirements apply:

* Candidates must have served a period of at least 12 consecutive months as a WCA Volunteer (this does not have to be a current position).
* Candidates must not be a serving member of the WCA Board, the WCA Regulations Committee, or the WCA Integrity Committee (or must be willing to relinquish the role upon appointment to this role).

<!-- break -->

### What does the WAC do?

The official rights and duties of the WAC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2025.4 - Appeals Committee](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.4%20-%20Appeals%20Committee.pdf). The WCA Appeals Committee is a small team that handles appeals made by members of the WCA affected by a decision made by either the WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) or the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC).

Members of the WAC examine the provided evidence and determine whether the grounds for an appeal are valid or not. Then, a thorough analysis of the original committee’s decision is made to reach a final verdict which can overturn or uphold the decision.

### Requirements and expectations

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

* At least 16 years of age as of April 1st, 2025.
* Availability throughout the week – expected time commitment of ~3 hours per week.
* Ability to communicate comfortably in written English.
* Ability to patiently communicate with people whose first language is not English.
* Ability to communicate constructively and respectfully, even when you disagree.
* Familiarity with the [WCA Regulations and Guidelines](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/), though it is not necessary nor expected that applicants have a perfect working knowledge.
* Familiarity with the [Code of Conduct](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Conduct.pdf) and the [Code of Ethics](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Ethics.pdf).
* Familiarity with the competition environment.

### How to Apply

Candidacy documents must include:

* A brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA and the cubing community.
* Overview of skills relevant to the role.
* Motivation for joining the WAC.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format. The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until April 11th, 2025, 23:59 UTC privately to Rui Reis (rreis@worldcubeassociation.org).

You can expect a reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WAC Leader and up to two other members.

Thank you for your interest in assisting the Appeals Committee and the WCA!

translation.title: WCA 申诉委员会成员招募（2025 年 3 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 申诉委员会（WAC）正在招募新成员！欢迎有兴趣的各界社区成员申请。鉴于 WAC 的工作性质，申请者须符合以下要求：

* 曾连续至少 12 个月担任 WCA 志愿者（目前不在任也可以）。
* 不得同时担任 WCA 董事会、WCA 规则委员会或 WCA 廉政委员会成员；如目前担任上述职务，须愿意在获任本职务时卸任。

### WAC 的工作是什么？

WAC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 动议 10.2025.4——申诉委员会](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.4%20-%20Appeals%20Committee.pdf)。WCA 申诉委员会规模较小，负责处理受到 WCA 廉政委员会（WIC）或 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）决定影响的 WCA 成员所提出的申诉。

WAC 成员会审查所提供的证据，判断申诉理由是否成立，再对原委员会的决定进行全面分析，作出维持或推翻原决定的最终裁决。

### 要求与期望

我们希望申请者符合以下条件：

* 截至 2025 年 4 月 1 日年满 16 岁。
* 一周内能安排时间处理工作，预计每周投入约 3 小时。
* 能熟练使用英语书面沟通。
* 能耐心与母语非英语的人沟通。
* 即使意见不同，也能尊重对方并进行有建设性的交流。
* 熟悉 [WCA 竞赛规则与指南](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/)；不要求申请者完全掌握所有规则及其应用。
* 熟悉[行为准则](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Conduct.pdf)和[道德准则](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/Code%20of%20Ethics.pdf)。
* 熟悉比赛环境。

### 如何申请

申请材料须包括：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 为 WCA 及魔方社区所做工作的概述。
* 与本职务相关的能力介绍。
* 加入 WAC 的原因。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式。申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2025 年 4 月 11 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料私下发送给 Rui Reis（rreis@worldcubeassociation.org）。

我们会回复并确认申请材料是否齐全。你也可能获邀参加由 WAC 负责人及最多两名其他成员进行的面试。

感谢你愿意为申诉委员会和 WCA 出一份力！
